description:
Problem (Advisor-confirmed, reports/Advisor48h.md): (H) _retry_reason (cli.py:1031-1048) returns 'its retry is due' for a same-head pending state before any failure counting; failed runs upload no state, so the head is re-dispatched on every develop push forever and never surfaced (probe test_state_path_redispatches_forever_after_failures). (M) A stateless retry is refused by the previous head's retry budget (retry.py:109-111 counts retries across heads), concludes success, and the PR goes silent. (M) verdict_runs (github.py:306-312) stops at GitHub's 1,000-run cap without error (total_count 1972 for 7 days). (L) Runs are tied to heads by committer date (sweep.py:71-81, author-controlled) and cancelled runs count as failures (sweep.py:7). (L) The stateless-marker branch in the plan never fires for sweep dispatches (dead). (Nit) The plan bypasses the budget on an owner reset while the sweep enforces it (retry.py:116-117 vs cli.py:1045-1047); queued runs count as spending a reset (sweep.py:97).

Outcome: same-head state path counts failed runs after state.updated_at and applies the stateless rule (dispatch once, surface on second failure, respect recent_dispatches vs daily_budget); recent_retries counts only the current head; a marked retry the plan refuses exits non-zero; verdict_runs raises when collected < total_count and the query window is narrowed (48 hours or the oldest open head's time); dispatches carry head=<sha> in the run name or input and runs are attributed by that, not committer date; cancelled runs are not failures; dead marker branch deleted; one documented reset rule shared by plan and sweep; queued runs never spend a reset.

Decision gates:
1. Reset rule: implement 'an owner reset ignores backoff and budget once, in both plan and sweep' (matches docs/agent/merge-authority.md); if code constraints force the other reading, stop and ask.
2. If tying runs to heads needs a workflow input change that alters the public dispatch interface for humans, record the new input in docs and proceed; if it needs a ruleset or environment change, stop and ask.

Item guardrails: fail closed (unknown attribution -> do not count as success, do not dispatch more than once per sweep per head); retry budgets and backoff values unchanged; build on #3565's listing code.

Merge freeze (owner 2026-10-27, scope: oracle-code PRs): no PR that changes oracle reviewer or gate code merges, and no make pr-arm runs on one, until oracle-history-edited-review-fail-closed-20261027 is merged. In scope: #3565, #3572, #3573, #3574, #3576, the unopened scope-path, evidence-exempt and redaction branches, and any other PR touching _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/, _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py, _project/scripts/soundness_merge_digest.py, scripts/pr_arm.py or .github/workflows/oracle-*.yml. Excepted: the edited-review fix's own PR and #3585 (owner exemption 2026-10-27). PRs may be opened and reviewed meanwhile. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, including on test PRs; edit-detection proofs use unit fixtures and read-only GraphQL reads of existing reviews.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build recorded in that item (SHA-256 fa41b27d434380e99b713e4f9ced0f73eb1fc0c409fdf23a57c119971d24bac5, from https://build.stencil.so/d/omp/20261017-231446-291e055/omp-darwin-arm64), verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge or a ruleset or settings change, and never a stand-in, adjudication or backoff reset unless the owner names the PR and head (and the finding) in the current request after an Owner instruction comment. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, and never post a commit status by hand. Run /oracle-review only on a pending or absent head, or after a Dispute: reply with file:line counter-evidence; never to re-roll a decided head. Do not close, reopen, rerun or rebase other PRs. Until oracle-gateway-cloud-builder-access-20261025 merges, publish only from the owner's Mac. Rollback: if a change to the verdict or gate workflows or to the local review breaks its first live run after merge in a way that blocks other PRs, stop, run make trunk-revert PR=<n>, and report to the owner, who chooses between an absence stand-in and the broken-oracle-gate procedure. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
